@graph.description: Pomegranate (Punica granatum) is a fruit whose juice and peel are rich in punicalagins and other polyphenols with antioxidant activity. Its best-studied cardiovascular effect is on blood pressure: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials found that drinking pomegranate juice modestly lowered both systolic and diastolic blood pressure, an effect seen across different doses and study durations. Pomegranate can inhibit drug-metabolizing enzymes, so, like grapefruit, it may interact with some medications; anyone taking prescription drugs regularly should check with a pharmacist.
